title: VN30-2: point-in-time cross-sectional 20-session ranking of VN30 members, long-only top-k after costs
question: Does any declared ranking of the VN30 members in force predict their next-20-session return relative to the equal-weight basket well enough that a long-only top-k portfolio beats equal-weight VN30 and the VN30 index after costs?

universe.evaluation: VN30 members in force on the decision date (contracts/vn30-membership.json, point in time, leavers kept until they leave)
universe.training: same as evaluation; a wider HOSE training universe is a NEW registered trial, not a change of this protocol
universe.history: decision dates from the first VN30 period in the membership file (2018-01-22) onward; bars before that only as feature warm-up

data.prices: adjusted daily OHLCV (VCI), finalized bars only, HOSE calendar sessions
data.limitFillProxy: a buy is not filled when open >= 1.065 x previous close, a sell is not filled when open <= 0.935 x previous close (adjusted-series proxy for limit-locked opens until raw prices and band data exist; the miss is carried to the next session)
data.snapshot: every run reads one frozen candle snapshot whose sha256 is recorded with the result

decisionSchedule.firstDecision: first session with >= 260 prior sessions for >= 20 members

target: excess return of member i from open(d+1) to open(d+21) over the equal-weight mean of all members in force at d (same window)

features.note: computed from data up to the close of d only; cross-sectionally rank-normalized to [-0.5, 0.5] per date; missing = 0

list.rev_1: minus the return over sessions d-21..d
list.vol_60: minus the std of daily log returns over the last 60 sessions
list.liq_20: log of the median of close x volume over the last 20 sessions

models.note: finite, fixed list; no hyperparameter search; every model below is one registered trial

list.rule: equal weight all members (benchmark, not ranked)
rank by the mean of the 8 rank-normalized features with signs as declared
ridge regression of target on the 8 features, alpha = 1.0, pooled over members and dates
LightGBM regressor on the 8 features: num_leaves 15, n_estimators 200, learning_rate 0.05, min_data_in_leaf 50, feature_fraction 0.8, bagging off, seed 20261106

portfolio.construction: long-only, equal weight top 10 by score; hysteresis: a holding is kept while its rank <= 15

costs.tickRule: HOSE tick size of the adjusted price band (10/50/100 VND)

portfolio.cash: unfilled weight stays in cash at 0%

benchmarks: equal-weight VN30 members in force (B-ew, same costs on rebalance)
VN30 index (price) when the series is available; E1VFVN30 when its series is available

validation.scheme: expanding walk-forward, refit at every calendar-year start

holdout.status: semi-sealed: the momentum family (B-mom_6, B-mom_12_1) was already seen there by VN30-1; holdout numbers for those two are reported but cannot confirm

validation.forward: from 2026-11-09: one immutable record per decision date and model (paper only); the post-FTSE-upgrade regime (2026-09-21 onward) is judged on forward data only

metrics.primary: mean cross-sectional Spearman rank IC between score and target over non-overlapping decision dates, with its t statistic
secondary: top-10 net excess return vs B-ew, annualized
net excess vs VN30 index when available
Sharpe and Sortino of net returns
hit rate of top-10 vs B-ew per period
metrics.multipleTesting: DSR of the best model's net excess series uses the HOSE trial count from trial_registry.py at evaluation time (statuses run + planned); PBO by CSCV over the 7 ranked models with 16 blocks

gates.development: M-ridge or M-lgbm passes only if its dev mean rank IC > B-composite's and > 0 with t >= 2
gates.holdout: the dev winner must show holdout mean rank IC > 0, top-10 net excess vs B-ew > 0, DSR >= 0.95 and PBO < 0.3
gates.forward: >= 6 months of forward paper with live mean rank IC >= half of the dev IC and net excess vs B-ew not clearly negative
gates.noGo: if no model passes, conclude that these price-only features carry no exploitable ranking edge on VN30 and keep B-ew / the index as the reference

outputs: docs/research/evidence/vn30-2/<run>/ (results, snapshot sha256, model list, registry head)
knownLimitations: 30 names give low power: rank IC must be about >= 0.035 for t = 2 over the dev window; a null result is the expected outcome
adjusted prices only: the limit-fill proxy is approximate and tick sizes follow adjusted, not traded, prices
membership history starts 2018-01-22; leavers need their own candles
